title: Visuomotor Robotic Pruning in Planar Orchards Using Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Dormant tree pruning is labor-intensive yet essential for maintaining modern high-productivity fruit orchards. In this work, we focus on pruning of modern planar tree training systems - V-Trellis apples and UFO cherries - where trunks and primary branches are trained into approximately planar walls. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline to learn a closed-loop visuomotor controller for robotic pruning. This controller is trained entirely using simulation and synthetically generated data and deployed in real orchards in a zero-shot manner. The pipeline comprises synthetic generation of planar orchard tree meshes, construction of a physics-based orchard simulator, automated collection of successful pruning trajectories via motion planning, and policy learning with a novel hybrid reinforcement-learning algorithm that combines offline demonstrations with online simulated rollouts. The controller uses optical-flow inputs from a wrist-mounted camera - avoiding the need for full 3D-reconstruction - and continuously guides the cutter through cluttered branch environments to a specified cutpoint with correct tool orientation. In exhaustive simulated task-space evaluations over 3,000 pruning points, the policy attains 49.9% success on V-Trellis apples and 46.0% on UFO cherries. We validate the learned controller across 38 physical trials - comprising 28 outdoor field trials in commercial and experimental orchards and 10 indoor laboratory tests - demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. The learned policy also outperforms a classical RRT-Connect baseline on physical hardware in laboratory trials.
tldr: 提出混合强化学习端到端视觉运动控制器，在平面果园实现零样本仿真到现实的机器人修剪。
motivation: 休眠期修剪劳动密集且对现代高产果园至关重要，而V-Trellis苹果和UFO樱桃等平面树形系统的自动化修剪仍具挑战。该工作旨在仅用仿真与合成数据学习闭环视觉运动控制器，并零样本部署到真实果园，避免依赖完整三维重建。
method: 构建端到端流水线：合成平面果园树网格、搭建基于物理的果园模拟器、通过运动规划自动采集成功修剪轨迹，并提出结合离线演示与在线仿真展开的混合强化学习算法。控制器以腕装相机光流为输入，持续引导切割器穿越杂乱枝条环境到达指定切割点并保持正确工具朝向。
result: 在覆盖3000个修剪点的穷举式仿真任务空间评估中，策略在V-Trellis苹果上成功率为49.9%，在UFO樱桃上为46.0%。在38项物理试验（28项商业与实验果园户外试验和10项室内实验室测试）中验证了零样本仿真到现实迁移，且学习策略在实验室硬件上优于经典RRT-Connect基线。
conclusion: 结果表明，仅用仿真与合成数据训练的视觉运动控制器可零样本迁移到真实平面果园修剪任务，混合强化学习与光流输入降低了对完整三维重建的依赖。该工作为自动化休眠期修剪提供了可扩展的农业机器人方案，并展示了在商业果园环境中的应用潜力。

title: SE(3) Neural Potential Fields for 6-DoF Trajectory Planning Directly from Images Without Explicit 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Reaching a 6-DoF grasp pose in clutter requires a collision-free trajectory, conventionally obtained by reconstructing the scene in 3D and planning inside that reconstruction, at the cost of its accuracy and compute. Potential fields learned directly from images remove that dependency but inherit the classical weakness of artificial potential fields: where attractive and repulsive gradients cancel, the descent grazes the obstacle instead of going around it, and can stall short of the goal. We present an SE(3) neural potential field learned from posed RGB images and supervised with a navigation function, the geodesic distance to the grasp through free space recovered from those same images during training, which removes both failures. On two tabletop scenes, from obstacle-blocked starts executed on a UR10, the field converges within 3 cm of the grasp from every start and every path it executes is collision-free against the ground-truth geometry, against 25% and 0% under image supervision alone; mean clearance rises from under a centimeter to 8.6-8.8 cm and arm-link contacts fall from 20.6-50.4% to 2.7-5.5% of executed configurations. Executed grasp success is 90.0% and 40.0% on the two scenes, the residual failures being refusals of the Cartesian executor rather than of the field. Planning takes about 2 s against 67-133 s for RRT* on a reconstruction of the same images, though under a common offline harness the two are comparable: the deployed margin is the cost of collision-checking a dense reconstruction, not planner complexity.
tldr: 提出SE(3)神经势场，直接从RGB图像规划6-DoF无碰撞抓取轨迹，无需显式3D重建。
motivation: 在杂乱环境中到达6-DoF抓取位姿需要无碰撞轨迹，传统方法先重建3D场景再规划，但重建精度与计算成本高。直接从图像学习势场可避免重建，却会继承经典人工势场中引力与斥力梯度抵消导致的贴障滑行和停滞问题。
method: 从带位姿的RGB图像中学习SE(3)神经势场，并在训练时用导航函数监督，该导航函数是从同一批图像恢复的自由空间中到抓取位姿的测地距离。该方法无需显式3D重建，通过势场下降生成6-DoF无碰撞轨迹。
result: 在两个桌面场景、UR10从障碍阻挡的起始点执行时，势场从每个起点都能收敛到抓取位姿3 cm以内，且所有执行路径相对真值几何均无碰撞；仅用图像监督时碰撞率分别为25%和0%。平均间隙从不足1 cm提升到8.6–8.8 cm，机械臂连杆接触配置比例从20.6–50.4%降至2.7–5.5%；两个场景抓取成功率为90.0%和40.0%，剩余失败主要来自笛卡尔执行器拒绝而非势场。规划约需2 s，而基于同一图像重建的RRT*需67–133 s；在统一离线测试框架下两者相当，部署时的差距主要来自稠密重建的碰撞检测成本。
conclusion: 用测地距离导航函数监督基于图像的SE(3)势场，可消除梯度抵消导致的贴障与停滞，实现直接从图像到6-DoF轨迹的规划，并显著提升间隙、降低接触与抓取失败。该方法为杂乱环境中的机器人抓取提供无需显式3D重建的规划范式，其部署速度优势主要来自避免稠密重建碰撞检测。

title: When Wider Views Fail: Stress-Testing Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models enable efficient geometry estimation from sparse images, but their pretrained nature can make them vulnerable to distribution shifts beyond their training data. Identifying these failure modes is important for understanding when such models can be reliably deployed in unconstrained imaging settings. We investigate viewpoint variation as a controlled distribution shift by varying the angular span of sparse image inputs while keeping the input budget fixed. Across multiple feed-forward reconstruction models, we observe substantial degradation as viewpoint span increases, with wide spans producing both incomplete surface coverage and geometry unsupported by the observed imagery. These results reveal that viewpoint variation can induce failure modes beyond conventional reconstruction incompleteness, highlighting the need to evaluate pretrained feed-forward models under distribution shifts that challenge their learned geometric priors.
tldr: 固定输入图像数量、增大视点跨度会显著降低前馈三维重建质量并引发新失效模式。
motivation: 前馈三维重建模型能从稀疏图像高效估计几何，但其预训练特性使其在训练分布之外易受分布偏移影响；理解这些失效模式对无约束成像场景的可靠部署至关重要。
method: 本文将视点变化作为受控分布偏移，在保持输入图像预算固定的前提下改变稀疏输入的角跨度，并在多个前馈重建模型上评估。
result: 实验观察到随着视点跨度增大，重建性能显著退化；宽跨度会导致表面覆盖不完整，并产生观测图像无法支持的几何。
conclusion: 结果表明视点变化会引发超越传统重建不完整性的新失效模式，强调需在挑战学习几何先验的分布偏移下评估预训练前馈模型。

title: Dynamic Thermal Gaussians: Multimodal 4D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Thermography plays a vital role in military and broader thermal analysis applications. Recent progress in 3D thermal reconstruction has extended temperature analysis from 2D to 3D space, yet most existing works assume static temperature distributions, neglecting the temporal dynamics of heat transfer in real-world environments. To address this limitation, we propose the first dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction framework for complex scenes. Our method jointly models RGB appearance, thermal observations, and scene geometry as they change over time. Specifically, we introduce a multimodal dynamic scene representation that anchors both the color and thermal modalities to a shared geometric substrate, ensuring their consistency under spatiotemporal deformations. We further design multimodal embeddings to enhance the motion expressiveness for each modality, and propose a multimodal routing mechanism that retains a unified set of shared multimodal Gaussians as the geometric backbone while adaptively spawning modality-specific Gaussians to strengthen the representational capacity in detail-rich regions of each individual modality. In addition, we contribute a novel benchmark dataset featuring high-frequency temperature variations to facilitate the evaluation of 4D reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity spatiotemporal reconstruction of both appearance and temperature. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/LinLif1869/DTG.
tldr: 提出首个动态 RGB-Thermal 4D 重建框架，用多模态高斯联合建模外观、温度与几何随时间变化。
motivation: 现有 3D 热重建多假设温度分布静态，忽略真实环境中热传递的时间动态，难以支持军事等热分析所需的动态温度场建模。本文旨在解决复杂场景下 RGB 与热成像的联合动态重建问题。
method: 方法将颜色与热模态锚定到共享几何基底，构建多模态动态场景表示，以保证时空变形下的一致性；并引入多模态嵌入增强各模态运动表达，以及多模态路由机制：保留统一共享多模态高斯作为几何主干，同时自适应生成模态专属高斯以增强细节丰富区域。还贡献了含高频温度变化的 4D 重建基准数据集。
result: 大量实验表明，该方法能够对场景外观和温度进行高保真时空重建；摘要未提供具体量化指标，但代码与数据集已开源。
conclusion: 该工作提出首个动态 RGB-Thermal 重建框架，扩展了热分析从静态 3D 到动态 4D 的能力，并通过新数据集推动 4D 热重建评测。其多模态高斯表示与路由机制有望促进复杂环境下动态热成像建模及相关应用。

title: STA-TFM: Spatio-Temporal Aggregation Across Views TransForMer for Pose Estimation
abstract: Monocular 3D human pose estimation (HPE) remains challenging due to depth ambiguity, occlu- sions, and the need for temporal consistency. While multi-view methods provide superior accuracy over monocular approaches, they often require complex setups. We introduce STA-TFM, a transformer-based architecture that combines spatial and temporal information for multi-view pose estimation. The approach leverages DSTformer, a monocular feature extractor, to capture long-range pose dependencies within each view. A fusion transformer then aggregates information across views to produce coherent 3D estimates. To address training data scarcity, we use a data generation pipeline that transforms any existing 3D pose dataset into multi-view setups with controllable parameters. Experiments on various datasets demonstrate that STA-TFM outperforms existing camera-parameter-free multi-view methods. STA-TFM achieves 50.9% and 49.5% reductions in mean per joint position error (MPJPE) and mean per joint velocity error (MPJVE) on the DHP19 dataset. Furthermore, it achieves 6.7% and 7.7% respective reductions on HAA4D, and a 15.2% MPJPE reduction on TotalCapture. STA-TFM handles noisy and missing 2D inputs, supporting potential deployment in healthcare monitoring, athletic assessment, and immersive technologies. Code, training checkpoints, and data are available at https://zenodo.org/records/22832620.
tldr: 提出STA-TFM，通过跨视角时空聚合Transformer实现3D人体姿态估计，显著降低MPJPE与MPJVE。
motivation: 单目3D人体姿态估计受深度歧义、遮挡和时序一致性不足困扰；多视角方法精度更高但通常需要复杂设置，且训练数据稀缺。
method: STA-TFM以DSTformer作为单目特征提取器捕获每个视角内的长程姿态依赖，再用融合Transformer跨视角聚合信息生成连贯3D估计；同时构建数据生成管线，将任意3D姿态数据集转换为参数可控的多视角设置以缓解数据稀缺。
result: 在多个数据集上，STA-TFM优于现有无需相机参数的多视角方法：DHP19上MPJPE和MPJVE分别降低50.9%和49.5%，HAA4D上分别降低6.7%和7.7%，TotalCapture上MPJPE降低15.2%，并能处理噪声和缺失2D输入。
conclusion: STA-TFM证明了时空聚合与跨视角Transformer在多视角3D姿态估计中的有效性，可支持医疗监测、运动评估和沉浸式技术等潜在部署；代码、训练检查点和数据已公开。

title: Estimating Accurate Hand Pose in Camera Space with Vision Transformer
abstract: Monocular RGB-based hand pose estimation has emerged as a critical research frontier in computer vision. The local hand pose estimation methods predict hand poses relative to the wrist, while global hand pose estimation also requires estimating the wrist's position in the camera coordinate system. However, this camera-space estimation confronts two fundamental challenges: (1) depth ambiguity in monocular settings, and (2) the coupling effect of hand local poses and global wrist positions in the perspective projections. In particular, this coupling reflects that the projections are jointly determined by local hand poses, wrist positions, and camera intrinsics. To overcome these challenges, our framework proposes two key innovations: Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision for hand-depth information extraction and Perspective Information Embedding for resolving above coupling effect of local pose and wrist position, both integrated within the mainstream encoder-decoder architecture. Besides, we propose a novel framerate-aware multi-dataset training strategy for sequential pose refinement. Our fully integrated approach achieves at most 37.1\% superiority in CS-MJE over SOTA on HO3D. Project page: https://github.com/Mine268/CS-ViT.
tldr: 提出CS-ViT框架，通过变换同构监督和透视信息嵌入解决单目相机空间手部姿态估计中的深度模糊与耦合问题。
motivation: 单目RGB手部姿态估计中，相机空间估计需同时预测手腕在相机坐标系的位置，面临深度模糊以及局部手姿与全局手腕位置在透视投影中的耦合效应两大挑战。该耦合体现在投影由局部手姿、手腕位置和相机内参共同决定。
method: 提出两项关键创新：Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision用于手部深度信息提取，Perspective Information Embedding用于解耦局部姿态与手腕位置，二者集成于主流encoder-decoder架构。此外，提出帧率感知的多数据集训练策略用于序列姿态细化。
result: 在HO3D数据集上，CS-MJE指标相比SOTA最多提升37.1%。
conclusion: 该框架有效解决了单目相机空间手部姿态估计中的深度模糊与耦合问题，在HO3D上取得显著提升，为相关研究提供了新思路。

title: DeCo: Efficient Decouple-to-Couple Learning for Multi-Task Visual Grounding
abstract: Multi-task visual grounding requires models to jointly understand linguistic semantics and perform accurate visual localization and segmentation. Despite the success of multimodal large language models, effectively adapting them to multiple grounding objectives remains challenging. Existing methods commonly enforce task cooperation through shared representations, while overlooking the intrinsic conflict between task-oriented feature interests. In this paper, we introduce $\textbf{DeCo}$, an efficient $\textbf{De}$couple-to-$\textbf{Co}$uple learning framework that resolves this dilemma through a two-stage paradigm: task-specific representation decoupling followed by complementary prior coupling. Specifically, we first propose Task-aware Semantic Decoupling (TSD) to route shared visual cues into individual features under salient word-level guidance, alleviating representation interference between localization and segmentation. Furthermore, we observe that segmentation naturally provides informative localization priors due to dense supervision. Based on this insight, we introduce Hybrid Prior Coupling (HPC), which integrates sentence-level semantic prior with mask-derived spatial prior for enhanced grounding. Built upon a frozen multimodal encoder, DeCo requires lightweight trainable parameters while achieving strong generalization across multiple grounding objectives. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, SARVG1.0, RRSIS-D, RIS-LAD, and RefDIOR demonstrate that DeCo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both natural and remote sensing benchmarks. The code and models are available at https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/DeCo.
tldr: DeCo提出解耦到耦合两阶段学习，以轻量参数实现多任务视觉定位SOTA。
motivation: 多任务视觉定位需同时理解语言语义并完成精确定位与分割，但现有多模态大模型方法依赖共享表示促进任务协作，忽视定位与分割之间的特征利益冲突，导致多目标适配困难。
method: DeCo采用两阶段范式：任务感知语义解耦（TSD）在显著词级引导下将共享视觉线索路由为任务专属特征，缓解定位与分割的表示干扰；混合先验耦合（HPC）融合句子级语义先验和掩码导出的空间先验以增强定位。整个框架基于冻结多模态编码器，仅需轻量可训练参数。
result: 在RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, SARVG1.0, RRSIS-D, RIS-LAD和RefDIOR等自然与遥感基准上，DeCo均达到SOTA；摘要未提供具体量化指标，但强调其轻量训练参数与跨多目标强泛化能力。
conclusion: 实验表明解耦再耦合策略能有效解决多任务特征冲突，为多任务视觉定位提供高效且泛化性强的方案，并覆盖自然与遥感场景；代码和模型已开源。

title: AnalogDepth: Multi-view Geometry from FPV drones under Analog Video Transmission
abstract:
Analog video transmission (VTX) remains widespread in FPV drones due to low latency, weight and low cost. However analog VTX suffers from complex spatially structured image degradation which differ fundamentally from digital image corruption (e.g. AWGN) used in standard training augmentation. This work shows that this type of noise severely degrades the accuracy of Depth Anything 3 (DA3), a state-of-the-art feed forward visual geometry foundation model.
  To address this gap, we present AnalogDepth, a parameter-efficient training pipeline that adapts DA3 to analog FPV imagery using student-teacher knowledge distillation with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) injected into the DINOv2 backbone. Rather than synthesizing noise analytically, we build a noise bank from static FPV recordings under diverse conditions and compare real-noise injection against PSD-matched Gaussian synthesis and AWGN as baselines. Experiments on six real FPV flight sequences across three indoor scenes show that training with our noise bank consistently reduces per-frame depth RMSE and 3D reconstruction Chamfer distance compared to the pretrained DA3 baseline and both Gaussian noise variants. These results demonstrate that replicating the spatial structure of real analog transmission noise is critical for effective adaptation.
tldr: 提出AnalogDepth，用真实模拟图传噪声库结合LoRA蒸馏微调DA3，提升FPV无人机深度估计与三维重建精度。
motivation: 模拟视频传输（VTX）因低延迟、轻量、低成本在FPV无人机中仍被广泛使用，但其图像退化具有复杂空间结构，与数字图像中常用的AWGN等噪声增强存在本质差异。现有前馈视觉几何基础模型Depth Anything 3（DA3）在该类噪声下精度严重下降，而针对模拟噪声的适配方法尚属空白。
method: 提出参数高效的训练流程AnalogDepth，以学生-教师知识蒸馏为主干，并在DINOv2 backbone中注入LoRA对DA3进行适配。不使用解析式噪声合成，而是从多条件下静态FPV录像构建真实噪声库，并设置PSD匹配高斯合成与AWGN两种基线进行噪声注入对比。
result: 在三个室内场景的六段真实FPV飞行序列上，使用该噪声库训练相比预训练DA3基线及两种高斯噪声变体，一致地降低了逐帧深度RMSE与三维重建Chamfer距离；摘要未提供具体数值指标。
conclusion: 结果表明，复现真实模拟传输噪声的空间结构是有效域适配的关键，噪声库增强优于解析式高斯噪声合成；该工作为FPV模拟图传下的多视图几何与深度估计提供了参数高效的适配范式。

title: OpenFlyScan: A Quality-Guided Aerial Reconstruction System for Consumer Drones
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides high-fidelity scenes for large-scale embodied simulation, but constructing large-scale urban assets remains constrained by expensive equipment and delayed quality feedback. Preset surveys can leave complex surfaces insufficiently observed, with defects discovered only after reconstruction, requiring return visits and repeated processing. We present OpenFlyScan, a quality-guided aerial reconstruction system for consumer drones that integrates a GS quality model, a reacquisition planner, and a custom-designed mobile app. The model learns from GS rendering errors to predict regional reconstruction quality. Based on these predictions, the planner then generates complementary reacquisition strips to be executed through the app, which also supports automated oblique surveys and data transfer without additional hardware on board. Across real aerial scenes, the model effectively identifies regions that are likely to be poorly reconstructed. In the Expo West field experiment, targeted reacquisition improves PSNR at additional views by 10.95 dB. With consumer drones, OpenFlyScan integrates capture, targeted reacquisition, and reconstruction to support rapid, low-cost urban asset creation. Code and models will be made publicly available at https://openflyscan.github.io/.
tldr: OpenFlyScan是面向消费级无人机的质量引导航拍重建系统，可预测重建缺陷并规划补采，低成本快速构建城市资产。
motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting虽能提供高保真场景，但大规模城市资产构建受昂贵设备和延迟质量反馈限制；预设航拍常导致复杂表面观测不足，缺陷需重建后才发现，造成返工。
method: 系统集成GS质量模型、重采集规划器和定制移动App；质量模型从GS渲染误差学习预测区域重建质量，规划器据此生成互补补采航线，App执行并支持自动倾斜摄影与数据传输，无需额外机载硬件。
result: 在真实航拍场景中，模型能有效识别可能重建不佳区域；Expo West现场实验中，针对性补采使额外视角PSNR提升10.95 dB。
conclusion: OpenFlyScan证明消费级无人机可整合采集、针对性补采与重建，支持快速低成本城市资产创建；代码和模型将公开。

title: Colon3R: Cross-Domain 3D Reconstruction from Monocular Colonoscopic Video
abstract: Monocular colonoscopic 3D reconstruction is important for surgical robotic colonoscopy, but remains challenging due to weak texture, specular reflections, limited view overlap, and non-rigid tissue motion. Conventional multi-view 3D reconstruction methods rely on stable correspondences and approximate rigidity, which are often violated in colonoscopy. Existing endoscopic methods often rely on domain-specific supervision, whereas there are not enough in-vivo labeled data available to adapt geometry foundation models to clinical colonoscopy. We present Colon3R, a cross-domain semi-supervised framework built on pretrained VGGT that transfers coupled camera, depth, and pointmap geometry from labeled phantom and simulated data to unlabeled in-vivo colonoscopy without requiring target-domain geometric annotations. Unlike source-only fine-tuning, which learns only from phantom and simulated data, Colon3R directly exploits unlabeled in-vivo video through teacher-derived cross-view supervision. Our proposed hierarchical quasi-rigid reliability selects reliable supervision at the sequence, directed-pair, and pixel levels, while source-preserving adaptation retains the learned coupled geometry during target-domain adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior overall performance over state-of-the-art approaches in depth, pointmap, and camera pose estimation. Qualitative comparisons on real in-vivo colonoscopy further show substantially more complete and geometrically consistent reconstructions than competing methods under clinical domain shift. The code will be public available after the paper is accepted.
tldr: Colon3R 提出跨域半监督框架，基于 VGGT 将标注体模与仿真数据的几何迁移至无标注活体结肠镜视频，实现更完整一致的 3D 重建。
motivation: 单目结肠镜三维重建对手术机器人结肠镜重要，但受弱纹理、镜面反射、视角重叠有限和非刚性组织运动影响；传统多视图方法依赖稳定对应与近似刚性假设，现有内窥镜方法依赖域内标注，而活体标注数据不足。
method: 基于预训练 VGGT 构建跨域半监督框架，利用教师模型生成的跨视图监督直接挖掘无标注活体视频；提出分层准刚性可靠性机制在序列、有向对和像素级筛选可靠监督，并用源域保持适配在目标域适配中保留已学到的耦合几何。
result: 大量实验表明，该方法在深度、点云图和相机位姿估计上总体优于现有最先进方法；真实活体结肠镜定性比较显示，在临床域偏移下重建更完整、几何更一致。
conclusion: Colon3R 无需目标域几何标注即可实现跨域 3D 重建，为临床结肠镜提供更鲁棒的几何基础模型适配方案，代码将在论文录用后公开。

title: Learning-Based 3D Reconstruction of Power Networks from Aerial Point Clouds
abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end framework for reconstructing overhead power utility network topology and extracting span-level physical metadata from large-scale aerial LiDAR. The pipeline begins with semantic segmentation of the input point cloud using an improved KPConv-based model, in which data sampling and loss functions are adapted to emphasize pole and conductor (wire) classes. Network topology inference then proceeds in two stages: (i) pole instances are obtained by clustering pole-class points and validating candidates using geometric criteria, including height and verticality estimated via PCA, and (ii) candidate pole pairs are evaluated using a heuristic method and a lightweight ResNet-based classifier on 2D top-view projections of pole and wire point distributions to determine whether a physical conductor span exists. By explicitly classifying candidate spans, the approach mitigates common failure modes of heuristic connectivity rules in dense or cluttered scenes and under partial wire observation. For each validated wire, attributes regarding utility infrastructure geometry are computed, including endpoint conductor heights, ground elevation, sag-related lowest-point features, conductor arrangement, and wire width. Evaluation on multiple real-world aerial LiDAR datasets demonstrates decimeter-level endpoint height accuracy and approximately 9% relative improvement in recall for topology reconstruction compared to heuristic nearest-neighbor baselines, with larger gains in complex layouts.
tldr: 提出端到端航拍LiDAR电力网重建框架，结合改进KPConv分割、杆塔聚类与ResNet跨距分类。
motivation: 从大规模航拍LiDAR中重建架空电力网络拓扑并提取跨距级物理元数据，解决启发式连通规则在密集杂乱或导线部分缺失场景中易失效的问题。
method: 流程先以改进KPConv语义分割突出杆塔与导线类；拓扑推断分两阶段，先用聚类和PCA高度/垂直度几何验证获取杆塔实例，再用启发式与轻量ResNet对2D俯视投影分类判断候选杆塔对是否存在物理导线跨距，并计算端点高度、地面高程、弧垂最低点、导线排列和线宽等属性。
result: 在多个真实航拍LiDAR数据集上，端点高度精度达到分米级，拓扑重建召回率较最近邻启发式基线约提升9%，在复杂布局中增益更大。
conclusion: 该端到端框架能有效重建电力网络拓扑并提取跨距级基础设施属性，显式跨距分类提升了复杂场景鲁棒性，对电力巡检和数字孪生具有应用潜力。

title: VGGT-Prime: Compute-Adaptive Mixture-of-Heads for Efficient Visual Geometry Transformers
abstract: Feed-forward visual geometry models such as the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) have recently enabled direct 3D reconstruction from multi-view images. Despite their promising performance, these models scale quadratically with the number of input views due to their global attention mechanism, resulting in substantial latency for long sequence inputs. There have been some recent efforts to accelerate VGGT, but they primarily focus on reducing \emph{token redundancy} through token merging or key/value sparsification. Our work resolves this bottleneck from a different perspective by investigating \emph{architectural redundancy} in visual geometry transformers. We show that the multi-head attention modules in VGGT's global-attention layers contain substantial architectural redundancy, with only a subset of heads carrying critical geometric information. In light of this observation, we propose VGGT-Prime, a compute-adaptive mixture-of-heads model that resolves this redundancy to accelerate visual geometry transformers while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality. The key idea of VGGT-Prime is to estimate the appropriate computation level for each global-attention head using a lightweight router and then dynamically assign each head to different computation modes. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that VGGT-Prime can achieve an {$8\times$} inference speedup over VGGT while maintaining competitive performance on camera pose, depth, and point-cloud predictions. We further show that VGGT-Prime is complementary to existing acceleration methods, such as token merging, further improving inference speed by up to $14{\times}$ over VGGT. An overview of our work is available on our \href{https://vggt-prime.github.io}{project page}.
tldr: VGGT-Prime通过轻量路由器为全局注意力头动态分配计算模式，在保持重建质量的同时实现最高14倍推理加速。
motivation: VGGT等前馈视觉几何模型因全局注意力随输入视图数二次增长，长序列推理延迟高；现有加速方法主要减少token冗余，未充分挖掘架构冗余。
method: 作者发现VGGT全局注意力层的多头注意力存在显著架构冗余，仅部分头携带关键几何信息；据此提出VGGT-Prime，用轻量路由器估计每个全局注意力头所需计算量，并将其动态分配到不同计算模式以减少冗余计算。
result: 在多个数据集上，VGGT-Prime相比VGGT取得8倍推理加速，并在相机位姿、深度和点云预测上保持有竞争力的性能；与token merging等现有加速方法互补，可进一步提升至最高14倍加速。
conclusion: 研究表明视觉几何Transformer的注意力头存在可利用的架构冗余，计算自适应混合头能在不显著损失重建质量的前提下大幅提升推理效率，并为现有token级加速方法提供正交补充。

title: G6D: Geometric Learning-Free RGB-D 6D Pose Solver for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: 6D object pose estimation is fundamental to robotic manipulation and automation. Recent zero-shot methods have significantly improved generalization to unseen objects, but most still rely on large-scale pretrained models with substantial GPU computation and memory demands. These requirements complicate deployment on robotic platforms where perception, planning, and control share limited computational resources, while learned intermediate representations offer limited geometric interpretability for task-specific adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose G6D, a learning-free, geometry-driven RGB-D 6D pose solver. Given an RGB-D observation, an object instance mask, camera intrinsics, and a CAD model, G6D generates pose hypotheses through template-based geometric matching and refines them using silhouette and depth consistency, forming a purely geometry-driven pose estimation paradigm. This paradigm requires neither pretrained visual models nor target-specific training and preserves interpretable geometric representations throughout pose estimation. Moreover, adjustable hypothesis counts provide flexible accuracy-computation trade-offs, while a CPU-only configuration supports deployment without GPU resources. Experiments on LineMOD and five BOP19 datasets demonstrate advanced performance. Real-world pick-and-place experiments further demonstrate G6D's applicability to robotic manipulation. The complete project is publicly available at https://ai4control.github.io/G6D-Project-Page .
tldr: G6D提出无需学习的几何驱动RGB-D 6D位姿求解器，兼顾精度与低算力部署。
motivation: 现有零样本6D位姿方法多依赖大规模预训练模型，GPU算力与显存开销大，难以部署在感知、规划与控制共享有限资源的机器人平台上；同时学习到的中间表征几何可解释性有限，不利于面向具体任务的适配。
method: G6D是一种无需学习、纯几何驱动的RGB-D 6D位姿求解器：给定RGB-D观测、物体实例掩码、相机内参与CAD模型，先通过基于模板的几何匹配生成位姿假设，再以轮廓与深度一致性进行精化。该范式无需预训练视觉模型与目标特定训练，全程保留可解释的几何表示，并可通过调整假设数量在精度与计算量之间灵活权衡，且支持纯CPU部署。
result: 在LineMOD及五个BOP19数据集上的实验表明其性能先进（摘要未给出具体量化指标），真实场景抓取-放置实验进一步验证了其在机器人操作中的可用性。
conclusion: G6D证明了不依赖预训练模型与GPU的纯几何位姿估计范式可在保持可解释性的同时获得有竞争力的精度，为资源受限的机器人平台提供了易于部署的6D位姿方案，项目已公开。

title: GARO: Geometry-Aware Redundancy Optimization for Real-Time and High-Fidelity Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Novel view synthesis is a key task for dynamic scene reconstruction, where high rendering speed is essential for applications such as virtual reality. Existing deformable Gaussian Splatting methods achieve high-fidelity dynamic scene modeling, but still face limitations in memory usage and rendering efficiency due to the large number of redundant Gaussians. To address these challenges, we propose Geometry-Aware Redundancy Optimization (GARO), a unified redundancy measurement framework in the adaptive density control stage of the traditional dynamic scene reconstruction pipeline. This framework first selects low-gradient candidates using an optimization activity assessment strategy, and then evaluates geometric complexity through low curvature analysis to further filter and prune redundant points, resulting in a compact and expressive Gaussian representation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that GARO achieves robust trade-offs between quality and speed, with PSNR remaining stable and rendering speed improved by 2x, validating the efficiency and effectiveness of GARO.
tldr: GARO通过几何感知冗余优化动态高斯泼溅，在保持PSNR的同时将渲染速度提升2倍。
motivation: 动态场景重建中的新视角合成需要高渲染速度，但现有可变形高斯泼溅方法因大量冗余高斯导致内存占用高、渲染效率低。
method: 提出GARO，在传统动态场景重建管线的自适应密度控制阶段构建统一冗余度量框架；先通过优化活动评估策略筛选低梯度候选，再利用低曲率分析评估几何复杂度以过滤和剪枝冗余点，得到紧凑且具表现力的高斯表示。
result: 在合成和真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，GARO在PSNR保持稳定的同时将渲染速度提升2倍，实现了质量与速度之间的稳健权衡。
conclusion: GARO验证了其效率与有效性，为实时高保真动态高斯泼溅提供了一种减少冗余、提升渲染效率的优化方案。

title: GAPS: Generative Active Pseudo-view Selection for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Novel view synthesis from sparse observations is severely under-constrained. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time rendering, it produces floaters, broken geometry, and washed-out backgrounds when trained with few views. We propose an alternating optimization framework that uses a pre-trained image diffusion model to generate geometrically consistent pseudo-views for additional 3DGS supervision. Generation is constrained by depth-conditioned ControlNet, IP-Adapter style transfer, LoRA scene adaptation, and img2img structural anchoring. We introduce Generative Active Pseudo-view Selection (GAPS) to balance reconstruction informativeness and generative reliability when choosing target views. Its annealing schedule shifts from conservative interpolation early in training to exploratory extrapolation later, gradually covering unobserved regions. A dual-criterion admission gate and uncertainty-weighted losses reject unreliable generations, while density-adaptive DropGaussian reduces overfitting in complex scenes. On LLFF with 3/6/9 views, our method improves average PSNR over vanilla 3DGS by 0.40/0.89/0.70 dB. On Mip-NeRF 360 with 12/24 views, the gains are 1.18/0.80 dB. SSIM improves and LPIPS decreases in every setting. Ablations show that active selection and density-adaptive regularization are both necessary; only the full method reduces LPIPS below the no-pseudo-view baseline on unbounded 360-degree scenes.
tldr: 提出GAPS主动伪视角选择，用扩散模型生成几何一致伪视角监督3DGS，提升稀疏视角新视图合成质量。
motivation: 稀疏观测下的新视角合成严重欠约束，3DGS在少视角训练时会产生浮点、破碎几何与泛白背景。现有生成式监督需在重建信息量与生成可靠性之间取得平衡，否则伪视角噪声会损害优化。
method: 提出交替优化框架，利用预训练图像扩散模型生成几何一致伪视角，并通过深度条件ControlNet、IP-Adapter风格迁移、LoRA场景适配与img2img结构锚定增强一致性。GAPS主动选择目标视角，其退火调度从早期保守插值转向后期探索外推；双准则准入、不确定性加权损失与密度自适应DropGaussian进一步拒绝不可靠生成并抑制复杂场景过拟合。
result: 在LLFF的3/6/9视角下，平均PSNR较vanilla 3DGS分别提升0.40/0.89/0.70 dB；在Mip-NeRF 360的12/24视角下提升1.18/0.80 dB。所有设置中SSIM提升、LPIPS下降；消融表明主动选择与密度自适应正则均必要，仅完整方法在无界360度场景使LPIPS低于无伪视角基线。
conclusion: GAPS通过生成与主动选择伪视角，有效缓解稀疏视角3DGS的欠约束问题并提升渲染质量。其贡献包括可平衡信息性与可靠性的主动伪视角选择机制及密度自适应正则，对稀疏视角三维重建与实时新视角合成具有潜在影响。

title: Semi-automated reconstruction of indoor geometry from 360-degree video for CFD-based airflow analysis in classrooms
abstract: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is widely used to evaluate ventilation and contaminant transport in occupied buildings, but deployment at scale is limited by three bottlenecks: acquiring room geometry without costly scanning hardware or manual CAD modeling, decomposing the scene into individually manipulable objects, and reconfiguring those objects for alternative layouts without re-capturing the room. We present a semi-automated workflow that converts a single 360-degree video of a room into individually editable, simulation-ready geometry assets. A dense point cloud is reconstructed using Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), and 2D instance masks from text-prompted SAM 3 segmentation are lifted to 3D using multi-view consensus and depth-band filtering. Points are separated into object instances with an octree, and occlusion gaps are healed with a connectivity graph. Chair templates are fitted by Iterative Closest Point (ICP) alignment, and table geometry is generated procedurally. A browser-based editor supports quality assurance and rapid construction of alternative layout configurations. A steady Reynolds-averaged OpenFOAM solution then drives transient passive-scalar transport; the setup is verified using a mesh-sensitivity study and validated against an IEA Annex 20 benchmark. We apply the workflow to two university classrooms and a tiered lecture-hall auditorium. The capture-to-geometry pass takes two to five hours per room on a consumer workstation. In a controlled obstruction sequence in one classroom, the modeled half-clearance time varies non-monotonically as furniture is added, and a cross-room comparison indicates that clearance behavior cannot be reliably extrapolated between rooms, motivating per-room geometry acquisition. By making that acquisition low-cost, the workflow makes geometry-resolved comparative ventilation studies practical for spaces such as classrooms.
tldr: 提出半自动工作流，用360度视频重建可编辑教室几何并用于CFD气流分析。
motivation: CFD在建筑通风与污染物输运评估中应用广泛，但规模化部署受限于三个瓶颈：无需昂贵扫描或手工CAD的几何获取、场景对象分解、以及不重新采集即可重配置布局。教室等空间需要逐房间几何获取，因此降低其成本具有实际意义。
method: 方法将单段360度视频通过NeRF重建稠密点云，利用文本提示SAM 3分割得到2D实例掩码，并经多视图一致性和深度带滤波提升到3D；再用八叉树分离物体实例、连通图修复遮挡缺口，ICP拟合椅子模板并程序化生成桌子几何。浏览器编辑器支持质量检查和替代布局快速构建，随后用OpenFOAM稳态RANS求解驱动瞬态被动标量输运，并通过网格敏感性研究和IEA Annex 20基准验证。
result: 工作流应用于两间大学教室和一个阶梯报告厅，消费级工作站上每房间从采集到几何耗时2-5小时。在一个教室的受控障碍序列中，模拟半清除时间随家具增加呈非单调变化；跨房间比较表明清除行为无法可靠外推。
conclusion: 该工作流通过低成本360度视频采集生成可编辑、可仿真几何，使逐房间的几何分辨比较通风研究变得可行。其贡献在于降低CFD前处理门槛，支持教室等空间的通风与污染物输运评估。

title: LiteTex-GS: Fast and Lightweight Texturing for Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Gaussian Splatting has enabled real-time novel view synthesis, but its tightly coupled geometry and appearance representation often require a large number of primitives to reproduce high-frequency texture details, leading to substantial memory and optimization costs. Recent textured 2D Gaussian methods alleviate this limitation by attaching texture maps to Gaussian primitives. However, bridging the fundamental structural gap between discrete Gaussians and continuous 2D grids requires complex parameterizations that introduce severe computational overhead. This overhead fundamentally compromises the original efficiency of Gaussian Splatting, making the balance between detailed texturing and computational agility an unresolved challenge. To address these challenges, we propose LiteTex-GS, a fast and lightweight texturing framework for Gaussian Splatting. Our method initializes an extremely compact representation, assigning minimal local texture to each Gaussian and progressively allocates higher resolution only to primitives with significant reconstruction errors. To maintain a streamlined geometric scaffold, we introduce a contribution- and area-aware pruning strategy that eliminates low-utility Gaussians. Furthermore, to mitigate the gradient dilution caused by texture upsampling, we design a resolution-aware update rule that preserves rapid and stable convergence. Extensive experiments on standard novel view synthesis benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive or superior rendering quality while using substantially fewer parameters and less training time than existing textured Gaussian baselines.
tldr: LiteTex-GS 以紧凑纹理初始化与渐进分辨率分配，实现快速轻量的高斯泼溅纹理化。
motivation: 高斯泼溅虽能实时合成新视角，但其几何与外观紧耦合的表示需要大量图元才能还原高频纹理，造成显著内存与优化开销；近期将纹理图附加到高斯的纹理化2D高斯方法，因离散高斯与连续2D网格之间的结构差异而依赖复杂参数化，带来严重计算负担，破坏了原有的高效性，使细节纹理与计算敏捷性的平衡成为未解难题。
method: 提出LiteTex-GS快速轻量纹理化框架：初始化极紧凑表示，为每个高斯仅分配最小局部纹理，并仅对重建误差显著的图元逐步分配更高分辨率；引入贡献与面积感知的剪枝策略剔除低效用高斯以保持精简几何骨架；设计分辨率感知更新规则，缓解纹理上采样引起的梯度稀释，维持快速稳定收敛。
result: 在标准新视角合成基准上的大量实验表明，该方法以显著更少的参数和更短的训练时间，取得了与现有带纹理高斯基线相当或更优的渲染质量（摘要未给出具体量化数值）。
conclusion: LiteTex-GS 通过紧凑表示、渐进纹理分配、贡献与面积感知剪枝及分辨率感知更新，在纹理细节与计算效率之间取得平衡，为高斯泼溅提供了一种轻量高效的纹理化方案，有望推动高质量实时渲染的实用化。

title: RegVGGT: Sustainable Visual Geometry Grounding for Streaming via Regulated Memory
abstract: 3D reconstruction from a lengthy video stream input poses a dilemma for feed-forward reconstruction models (FFRMs), that a whole-stream inference context cannot be retained under limited GPU memory.Recent studies seek to resolve this problem via a trade-off between the integrity of inference context and GPU memory usage, which either suffer from a rapid memory inflation or degraded context integrity due to artificially capping memory usage.Driven by our key observation that the initial saliency of a token reliably dictates its long-term importance across the stream, we propose RegVGGT, a training-free token regulation method which aggressively regulates the tokens of incoming frames.By admitting at most 1% of tokens per frame to update the context memory, our method dramatically suppresses memory inflation as the stream progresses.Equipped with a FlashAttention-compatible token saliency estimation scheme, RegVGGT is capable of processing thousands of frames on a consumer-grade GPU with negligible compromise to reconstruction quality.Extensive experiments demonstrate that RegVGGT achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon benchmarks across diverse FFRM prediction tasks, surpassing prior FFRM-based stream reconstruction baselines by a large margin.
tldr: 免训练 RegVGGT 以每帧最多 1% token 更新记忆，实现长视频流式三维重建。
motivation: 长视频流式三维重建中，前馈重建模型（FFRM）难以在有限 GPU 显存下保留全流推理上下文；现有方法在上下文完整性与显存占用间权衡，常导致显存快速膨胀或上下文完整性下降。
method: 基于 token 初始显著性可可靠决定其全流长期重要性的观察，提出免训练 token 调控方法 RegVGGT；每帧最多接纳 1% token 更新上下文记忆，并采用 FlashAttention 兼容的显著性估计，从而持续抑制显存膨胀。
result: 在多种 FFRM 预测任务的长时程基准上达到 SOTA，显著超越先前基于 FFRM 的流式重建基线；可在消费级 GPU 上处理数千帧，且重建质量几乎不受影响。
conclusion: RegVGGT 通过受调控记忆实现可持续的流式视觉几何 grounding，为长视频流三维重建提供免训练、低显存且高保真的解决方案，并具备扩展到更广 FFRM 任务的潜力。

title: GrapeSplat: Geometry-Grounded Reconstruction via Amalgamated Pose-Free Encoding for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting now reconstructs renderable scenes from unposed, uncalibrated images. Yet, most models supervise only photometric consistency and predict Gaussians pixel by pixel, which leaves global structure fragile and ties primitive count to image resolution and view count. To this end, GrapeSplat amalgamates multi-view cues into a voxel-aligned scene representation and decodes Gaussians directly from the learned grid, requiring no per-scene optimization or post-processing. An Atlas Encoder lifts all views into pixel-wise geometry-and-appearance features anchored at predicted 3D points. PEACH-Vox compands the unbounded scene into a bounded sparse grid through a smooth per-axis map with an exact closed-form inverse. The Sparse Decoder then consolidates the grid with sparse convolutions and decodes the full scene as multiple Gaussians per occupied cell. This amalgamated representation exploits sparse voxel occupancy, where the Gaussian count follows the occupied cells and saturates as views cover the scene, while grid resolution sets its ceiling. GrapeSplat turns unposed images into a renderable Gaussian scene in a single forward pass. Trained with 2D and 3D supervision on 8-view sequences, it generalizes zero-shot from 4 to 64 views across indoor and unbounded scenes. Code and trained weights are available at https://github.com/VAISR/GrapeSplat
tldr: GrapeSplat 将无位姿多视图融合为稀疏体素表示，单次前向即可重建可渲染的3D高斯场景。
motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法多仅以光度一致性监督并逐像素预测高斯，导致全局结构脆弱，且高斯基元数量受图像分辨率和视图数限制。
method: GrapeSplat 将多视图线索融合为体素对齐场景表示：Atlas Encoder 把各视图提升为锚定预测3D点的像素级几何-外观特征，PEACH-Vox 通过逐轴平滑映射及其精确闭式逆将无界场景压缩为有界稀疏网格，Sparse Decoder 以稀疏卷积聚合网格并每占用单元解码多个高斯，无需逐场景优化或后处理。
result: 在8视图序列上以2D与3D监督训练，模型可从4至64视图零样本泛化到室内与无界场景；摘要未提供PSNR/SSIM等具体量化数值。
conclusion: GrapeSplat 能单次前向从无位姿图像生成可渲染高斯场景，并使高斯数量随占用单元和视图覆盖趋于饱和，从而将基元数与视图/分辨率解耦，为可扩展前馈3DGS提供几何锚定方案。

title: VDGS: Visibility-Driven Large-Scale 3D Gaussian Splatting for Aerial Scene Reconstruction
abstract: Large-scale scene reconstruction is a critical foundational technology in robotic autonomous systems such as 3D mapping and autonomous driving. In recent years, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable advantages in both visual quality and computational efficiency, making it a promising representation for large-scale scene reconstruction. However, it still faces challenges in large-scale scenes, including excessive memory consumption and uneven viewpoint coverage caused by UAV acquisition, limiting its real-world applications. To address this, we propose VDGS, a novel 3DGS framework that incorporates camera distribution into scene modeling. VDGS introduces visibility-driven statistics for scene anchors to quantify supervision strength. These statistics are further leveraged for scene partitioning and for gradient compensation in under-optimized regions, thereby promoting balanced optimization across different regions. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale aerial scene datasets demonstrate that, under imbalanced viewpoint distributions, VDGS consistently outperforms existing methods, while maintaining competitive performance in scenarios with more uniform view distributions.
tldr: 提出可见性驱动的3DGS框架VDGS，通过场景锚点监督统计实现大尺度航拍场景均衡优化。
motivation: 面向机器人自主系统中的三维建图与自动驾驶，大尺度航拍场景重建需兼顾视觉质量与计算效率。现有3DGS在无人机采集导致的内存开销大、视角分布不均和区域优化不平衡等问题上仍受限。
method: VDGS将相机分布纳入场景建模，为场景锚点引入可见性驱动的监督强度统计。基于该统计进行场景划分，并对欠优化区域实施梯度补偿，从而促进不同区域均衡优化。
result: 在多个大规模航拍场景数据集上，面对不均衡视角分布，VDGS持续优于现有方法；在视角分布较均匀时也保持有竞争力的性能。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: VDGS通过可见性驱动统计缓解大尺度3DGS的监督不均问题，提升航拍场景重建的鲁棒性与均衡性，为机器人三维建图等应用提供更实用的大场景重建方案。

title: SomaNet: Weakly Supervised Learning for Instance Soma Segmentation in 3D Electron Microscopy with Partial Annotations
abstract: Soma instance segmentation, i.e., identifying and delineating individual cell somas as distinct instances, is crucial for cellular analysis and connectomic reconstruction. Three-dimensional electron microscopy (3D EM) provides nanometer-scale resolution for capturing fine-grained soma morphology. However, dense instance-level manual annotation is prohibitively costly, limiting the scalability of fully supervised methods. To address this challenge, we propose SomaNet, a weakly supervised framework for 3D EM soma instance segmentation under partial annotation constraints. SomaNet adopts a teacher--student learning paradigm tailored to partial labels. The teacher is trained using partially annotated data to generate pseudo-labels, while the student jointly learns from the partial ground-truth annotations and the generated pseudo-labels, progressively recovering dense instance segmentations. To accurately delineate cell somas under limited supervision with varying instance counts, SomaNet incorporates affinity learning, which encourages high similarity within instances and low similarity across instance boundaries. Semantic-guided affinity decoding and 2D-to-3D reconstruction then produce volumetrically consistent 3D soma instances while preserving the large receptive fields of 2D backbones. The framework is architecture-flexible and supports diverse backbones, including vision transformers and foundation models, enabling direct transfer of pretrained visual representations to volumetric EM segmentation. Experiments on 3D EM brain datasets demonstrate that SomaNet achieves accurate and robust soma instance segmentation across regions with diverse soma morphologies under partial annotation. Code is available at https://github.com/mkhateri/SomaNet.
tldr: SomaNet提出弱监督教师-学生框架，用部分标注实现3D电镜胞体实例分割。
motivation: 3D电子显微镜可提供纳米级胞体形态，但稠密实例级人工标注代价过高，限制全监督方法的可扩展性；本文旨在部分标注约束下实现胞体实例分割。
method: 提出SomaNet教师-学生框架：教师用部分标注训练生成伪标签，学生联合学习部分真值与伪标签以逐步恢复稠密实例分割；引入亲和度学习，通过语义引导亲和度解码和2D到3D重建生成体积一致的3D胞体实例，并兼容ViT与基础模型等2D骨干以保留大感受野。
result: 在3D EM脑数据集上，SomaNet在部分标注下对不同胞体形态区域均实现准确且鲁棒的胞体实例分割；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: SomaNet为部分标注3D EM胞体实例分割提供可扩展的弱监督方案，降低标注成本并支持预训练视觉表征迁移至体积EM分割，代码已开源。

title: Compressing 3D Gaussian Splatting via Cross-Representation Priors
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel view synthesis but incurs high storage and transmission costs due to dense Gaussian primitives. Recent anchor-based compression reduces per-primitive redundancy, yet redundancy across anchors remains largely unexploited. We propose CRP-GS (Cross-Representation Priors for Gaussian Splatting), a rate-distortion optimized compression framework that leverages cross-representation priors to improve anchor-level entropy modeling. First, a Correspondence-Oriented Hierarchical Structure (COHS) organizes anchors by feature correspondence rather than spatial proximity, constructing root-leaf dependencies so that selected anchors can act as informative priors to conditionally encode others, yielding more accurate likelihood prediction and lower conditional entropy. Second, Shared Feature Aggregation (SFA) extracts globally shared features from a contextual hash grid and injects them into anchor representations, factoring out scene-consistent low-frequency information that would otherwise be redundantly embedded in individual anchors. Both modules are trained under a unified rate-distortion objective to balance bitrate reduction and rendering fidelity. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that CRP-GS achieves a favorable overall rate-distortion trade-off, yielding around 30% average bitrate reduction compared to anchor-based baselines while maintaining comparable rendering quality.
tldr: 提出CRP-GS，利用跨表示先验改进3DGS锚点压缩，平均降低约30%码率并保持渲染质量。
motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting虽能实现高质量新视角合成，但稠密高斯基元带来高昂存储与传输成本。现有基于锚点的压缩方法减少了单基元冗余，却未充分利用锚点之间的冗余。
method: 提出CRP-GS，在统一率失真优化框架下引入跨表示先验。COHS按特征对应而非空间邻接组织锚点，构建根叶依赖，使选定锚点作为先验条件编码其他锚点以降低条件熵；SFA从上下文哈希网格提取全局共享特征并注入锚点表示，去除场景一致的低频冗余。
result: 在多个基准上取得更优的整体率失真权衡，相比基于锚点的基线平均码率降低约30%，同时保持可比的渲染质量。
conclusion: 表明跨锚点与跨表示先验能有效提升3DGS压缩的率失真性能，为高斯基元压缩提供新思路，有利于降低存储与传输开销。

title: D3GS: Depth, DINO, and RGB Diffusion Co-Guided 3D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Reconstruction
abstract: Novel view synthesis from sparse inputs remains challenging for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) due to ambiguous geometry, cross-view inconsistency, and missing details in under-constrained regions, resulting in degraded reconstruction and unstable rendering. To tackle these issues, we propose D$^{3}$GS, a Depth-DINO-Diffusion guided sparse-view Gaussian reconstruction framework that jointly enhances geometry and appearance. D$^{3}$GS first recovers a high-resolution, metric depth map via diffusion-based completion and DPT (Dense Prediction Transformer) refinement, providing robust Gaussian initialization and geometric constraints. Then, a DINO-guided view-consistent learning is introduced to augment Gaussian attributes with structural features, improving multi-view consistency. Finally, a diffusion-based Gaussian refinement module injects generative priors into an iterative optimization strategy, enhancing high-frequency geometric and appearance details within the Gaussian representation. Experiments on DTU, LLFF, and Mip-NeRF 360 show that D$^{3}$GS achieves consistent and substantial improvements over strong baselines, with ablation studies validating the effectiveness and complementary roles of each component.
tldr: D3GS 联合深度、DINO 与扩散先验，提升稀疏视角 3D 高斯重建的几何与外观质量。
motivation: 稀疏输入下 3DGS 面临几何歧义、跨视图不一致及欠约束区域细节缺失，导致重建退化与渲染不稳定。D3GS 旨在同时增强几何与外观，解决稀疏视角高斯重建难题。
method: D3GS 先用扩散补全与 DPT 细化恢复高分辨率度量深度图，为高斯提供初始化与几何约束；再用 DINO 引导的视图一致性学习增强高斯属性结构特征；最后以扩散式高斯细化模块注入生成先验，迭代优化高频几何与外观细节。
result: 在 DTU、LLFF、Mip-NeRF 360 上，D3GS 相较强基线取得一致且显著提升，消融实验验证各组件有效且互补；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: D3GS 通过深度、DINO 与 RGB 扩散协同引导，有效缓解稀疏视角 3DGS 的几何与外观退化，为稀疏视图重建提供新思路。

title: LINGO: Latent Initialization and Gradient Optimization for Sparse-view X-ray Novel View Synthesis and CT Reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: In novel view synthesis and Computed Tomography (CT) reconstruction with sparse-view X-ray imaging, insufficient angular coverage leads to structural ambiguity and accumulated noise. Integrating 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with X-ray absorption physics can achieve promising results, but it suffers from noisy initialization, positional insensitivity, and weak gradients in low-density regions. In this paper, we propose a unified Latent Initialization and Gradient Optimization (LINGO) framework to address these issues. LINGO combines latent mask-space initialization with dynamic gradient optimization to improve point cloud structural completeness while accelerating training. It constructs voxel-level 3D filters from X-ray masks to robustly suppress background noise and provide reliable geometric priors. By employing an adaptive voxel scaling strategy and dynamically scaling loss, LINGO can adjust spatial resolution and explicitly amplify gradients in low-density structures. To evaluate the quality of initialization, we introduce the Initialization Point Cloud Structural Deviation (IPSD) metric. Experiments on the X3D dataset indicate that for the novel view synthesis task, LINGO improves the Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) by an average of 0.72 and 0.0039, respectively, over baselines under identical sparse-view settings, achieving comparable reconstruction quality within 5k steps to state-of-the-art models typically trained with 30k iterations. For the CT reconstruction task, LINGO also demonstrates consistent improvements, with average PSNR and SSIM gains of 0.36 and 0.0134. These results highlight LINGO's effectiveness in both accelerating training and enhancing reconstruction quality across different sparse-view imaging scenarios.
tldr: LINGO通过潜在掩码初始化与动态梯度优化提升稀疏视角X射线新视角合成和CT重建质量并加速训练。
motivation: 稀疏视角X射线成像因角度覆盖不足导致结构模糊与噪声累积；将3D Gaussian Splatting与X射线吸收物理结合虽有前景，却受初始化噪声、位置不敏感和低密度区梯度弱等问题制约。
method: 提出统一的LINGO框架，融合潜在掩码空间初始化与动态梯度优化；从X射线掩码构建体素级3D滤波器以抑制背景噪声并提供几何先验；采用自适应体素缩放和动态损失缩放，调整空间分辨率并显式增强低密度结构梯度；同时引入IPSD指标评估初始化点云结构偏差。
result: 在X3D数据集相同稀疏视角设置下，新视角合成任务PSNR和SSIM平均提升0.72和0.0039，5k步即可达到通常需30k迭代的SOTA模型相当的重建质量；CT重建任务PSNR和SSIM平均提升0.36和0.0134。
conclusion: LINGO可同时加速训练并提升不同稀疏视角成像场景下的合成与重建质量，为基于3DGS的稀疏X射线新视角合成和CT重建提供了有效的初始化与梯度优化方案。

title: PanoSeg3R: Feed-Forward 3D Semantic Segmentation for Panoramic Images with an Automatic Data Curation Pipeline
abstract: We present PanoSeg3R, a feed-forward framework for 3D panoramic semantic segmentation. Unlike existing methods designed for perspective inputs, PanoSeg3R jointly predicts 3D geometry and multi-view semantic segmentation in one single forward pass. Built upon a pretrained reconstruction backbone that supports panoramic images, our approach extends feed-forward 3D reconstruction with a query-based mask decoder. Furthermore, we introduce an automatic panorama data curation pipeline that leverages the complementary strengths of off-the-shelf foundation models to generate reliable pseudo semantic annotations, substantially expanding the training data and improving zero-shot generalization. PanoSeg3R achieves state-of-the-art performance on panoramic 3D semantic segmentation, improving 3D mIoU by up to 16.02 on ScanNet++, while the curated training data further improves zero-shot performance by up to 4.26 and 43.28 mIoU on Stanford2D3D and ToF-360, respectively. Website: https://harryyoon777.github.io/PanoSeg3R/
tldr: PanoSeg3R 提出前馈全景 3D 语义分割框架，联合预测几何与多视角语义，并通过自动数据整理提升零样本泛化。
motivation: 现有方法多面向透视输入，难以直接处理全景图像，且全景 3D 语义分割缺乏充足训练数据，零样本泛化能力有限。
method: 基于支持全景图像的预训练重建骨干，扩展前馈 3D 重建并加入基于查询的掩码解码器，在单次前向中联合预测 3D 几何与多视角语义分割；同时提出自动全景数据整理流水线，利用现成基础模型生成可靠伪语义标注以扩充训练数据。
result: 在全景 3D 语义分割上达到 SOTA，ScanNet++ 的 3D mIoU 最高提升 16.02；整理后的训练数据在 Stanford2D3D 和 ToF-360 上分别将零样本性能最高提升 4.26 和 43.28 mIoU。
conclusion: 表明前馈框架结合自动数据整理能有效推进全景 3D 语义分割，并显著增强零样本泛化能力，具有扩展训练数据与提升跨数据集迁移的潜力。

title: Info3R: Information-Adaptive Test-Time Training for 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Transformer-based models have recently achieved strong performance on 3D reconstruction from images, and recent works extend them to process video streams in an online manner for real-world deployment. However, existing methods overlook two key signals when handling long image streams: the importance of each incoming frame and the information saturation of the model's internal state. In this paper, we propose Info3R, a novel information-adaptive test-time training method for the online 3D reconstruction. We introduce an information-aware state update that modulates the state update strength based on the redundancy and informativeness of each incoming frame. To restore the state's plasticity -- its capacity to incorporate new observations -- we propose a dynamic state reset, triggered by the cumulative magnitude of state updates and the model's prediction confidence and accompanied by an anchor-to-world alignment. Our method achieves consistent improvements on camera pose estimation, video depth estimation, and 3D reconstruction, while substantially mitigating the performance degradation in the long sequence evaluation. Notably, on KITTI Odometry, our method achieves on average 1.68x lower ATE than LongStream, demonstrating its robustness on extended outdoor sequences.
tldr: Info3R通过信息自适应测试时训练，依据帧信息量与状态饱和动态更新和重置状态，提升在线3D重建的长序列性能。
motivation: 现有在线3D重建方法处理长图像流时，忽略了每个新帧的重要性以及模型内部状态的信息饱和问题，导致长序列中性能明显退化。
method: 提出信息感知状态更新，根据每帧的冗余度与信息量调节状态更新强度；并利用累计状态更新幅度和预测置信度触发动态状态重置，同时配合anchor-to-world对齐恢复状态可塑性。
result: 在相机位姿估计、视频深度估计和3D重建任务上均取得一致提升，并显著缓解长序列性能退化；在KITTI Odometry上，平均ATE相比LongStream降低1.68倍。
conclusion: Info3R为在线3D重建提供了一种信息自适应测试时训练框架，增强了长序列与户外扩展场景下的鲁棒性，具有实际部署潜力。

title: SFVO: Decoupled Confidence-Guided Stereo-Flow Visual Odometry with Bidirectional PnP
abstract: Deep learning-based visual odometry (VO) has achieved significant progress, yet most existing methods focus on a monocular approach, which suffers from scale ambiguity. Stereo VO provides real metric by its nature, but remains less studied in deep learning VO due to its high computational cost and modeling complexity. Recent advances in stereo matching and optical flow estimation have made dense visual correspondence increasingly accurate and reliable, but their complementary geometric information has not been fully exploited for VO. In this paper, we present SFVO, a correspondence-driven stereo VO framework that directly builds upon pretrained stereo matching and optical flow models. SFVO exploits pretrained stereo matching and optical flow models to estimate stereo and temporal correspondences. Instead of learning pose directly from images, SFVO maps learned correspondences into geometric constraints and predicts which points are trustworthy. To improve the reliability of visual correspondence-based geometric constraints, we introduce decoupled confidence maps for rotation and translation. This design better aligns the characteristics of visual correspondence and 6-DoF transformations. Extensive experiments on outdoor and indoor datasets demonstrate that SFVO achieves robust and accurate pose estimation with strong generalization capability. The code will be released.
tldr: SFVO复用预训练双目匹配与光流构建几何约束，并用旋转/平移解耦置信图引导双向PnP，实现鲁棒双目视觉里程计。
motivation: 现有深度学习视觉里程计多集中于单目方案，存在尺度模糊问题；双目视觉里程计天然提供真实尺度，但因计算成本高和建模复杂而在深度学习中研究不足。此外，双目匹配与光流估计虽日益准确，其互补几何信息尚未在VO中被充分挖掘。
method: SFVO以预训练双目匹配和光流模型估计双目与时序对应关系，不直接从图像学习位姿，而是将对应关系转化为几何约束并预测哪些点可信。为更好匹配视觉对应与6-DoF变换特性，方法引入旋转和平移解耦的置信图，并结合双向PnP求解位姿。
result: 在室外和室内数据集上的大量实验表明，SFVO能实现鲁棒、准确的位姿估计，并具有较强泛化能力；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: SFVO提出了一种对应关系驱动的双目视觉里程计框架，通过复用预训练匹配/光流模型并解耦置信度引导几何约束，缓解了单目尺度模糊和双目建模复杂问题。该工作为深度双目VO提供了可泛化的新思路，代码将开源。

title: HAT: Hypothesis-Anchored Tracking for Video Monocular Spacecraft Pose Estimation
abstract: Monocular 6-DoF pose estimation of non-cooperative targets is important for on-orbit servicing and debris removal. A single-image estimator can confuse near-symmetric spacecraft orientations, and tracking can preserve an incorrect pose. We present Hypothesis-Anchored Tracking (HAT), a causal framework that uses inter-frame motion to select among competing CAD-based pose hypotheses before alignment and fusion. Rather than independently choosing the highest-scoring hypothesis in each image, HAT retains competing orientation histories and selects a pose to anchor the relative trajectory estimated by monocular SLAM. Sparse anchors and pose fusion provide per-frame estimates after initialization without revising past outputs. The method requires only a calibrated RGB sequence, a metric CAD model, and target image regions, which can be supplied by detection or segmentation. The pretrained pose and SLAM networks require no target-specific training or fine-tuning. We evaluate two versions, Mega-HAT and Pico-HAT, using MegaPose and PicoPose, on SPARK-2024, SwissCube and SHIRT, with YCB-Video assessing performance outside the space domain. Using one temporal configuration per method, the arithmetic means of the four dataset-wise comparisons show 9.4% lower mean pose error and 3.76 times the sustained input FPS for Mega-HAT relative to independent MegaPose, and 23.9% lower mean pose error and 2.42 times the FPS for Pico-HAT relative to independent PicoPose. Mega-HAT ablations on SPARK and an offline reference examine component contributions and the effect of revising past estimates.
tldr: HAT 利用帧间运动在竞争位姿假设中选择锚点并结合 SLAM 融合，实现高效无目标训练的航天器单目位姿估计。
motivation: 非合作目标单目 6-DoF 位姿估计对在轨服务和碎片清除至关重要，但单图估计易混淆近对称航天器朝向，跟踪又可能持续保留错误位姿。HAT 旨在利用帧间运动在竞争假设中稳健选择并锚定位姿，避免错误累积。
method: HAT 是一个因果框架，保留多个候选朝向历史，在对 CAD 位姿假设进行对齐与融合前，利用帧间运动选择锚定假设，并用其锚定单目 SLAM 估计的相对轨迹；稀疏锚点和位姿融合在初始化后提供逐帧估计且不修改过去输出。方法仅需标定 RGB 序列、度量 CAD 模型和目标图像区域，预训练位姿与 SLAM 网络无需目标特定训练或微调。
result: 在 SPARK-2024、SwissCube、SHIRT 及 YCB-Video 上评估 Mega-HAT 和 Pico-HAT（分别基于 MegaPose 和 PicoPose）；四数据集比较的算术平均显示，Mega-HAT 较独立 MegaPose 平均位姿误差降低 9.4%、持续输入 FPS 为 3.76 倍，Pico-HAT 较独立 PicoPose 误差降低 23.9%、FPS 为 2.42 倍。SPARK 消融和离线参考进一步分析各组件贡献及修改过去估计的影响。
conclusion: HAT 在无需目标特定训练的情况下提升了单目航天器位姿估计精度与实时性，并通过假设锚定和位姿融合缓解近对称目标错误。该框架对在轨服务、碎片清除等空间应用具有潜在价值。

title: 2D GauSS-MI: Efficient Active Scene Reconstruction with Balanced Visual and Geometric Quality
abstract: Active reconstruction requires efficient active view selection to achieve high-quality reconstruction within limited onboard computational resources. Existing methods face challenges in adequately balancing visual and geometric quality with the computational efficiency required for real-time operation. In this work, we present an active reconstruction framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS). We develop an efficient online 2DGS mapping pipeline for incremental RGB-D observations and introduce a probabilistic reliability model that characterizes the view-dependent reconstruction quality of individual 2D Gaussian splats. Building on this model, we formulate 2D Gaussian Splatting Shannon Mutual Information (2D GauSS-MI), a mutual-information-based metric that exploits the explicit surface orientation of 2DGS to evaluate the expected information gain of candidate views. The proposed metric enables active view selection to account for both visual and geometric reconstruction quality. We evaluate the proposed system against three state-of-the-art baselines on eight Replica scenes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves a favorable balance between visual and geometric reconstruction quality with substantially lower computational cost and competitive model storage.
tldr: 提出基于2DGS的主动重建框架，用2D高斯香农互信息选视角，兼顾视觉与几何质量并降低计算成本。
motivation: 现有主动重建方法难以在有限机载计算资源下同时兼顾视觉质量、几何质量与实时运行效率，因此需要更高效的主动视角选择策略。
method: 构建面向增量RGB-D观测的在线2DGS建图流程，并引入概率可靠性模型刻画单个2D高斯溅射的视角相关重建质量；在此基础上提出2D GauSS-MI指标，利用2DGS显式表面朝向计算候选视角的期望信息增益，使主动视角选择同时考虑视觉与几何重建质量。
result: 在八个Replica场景上与三个最先进基线方法对比，实验表明该方法在视觉与几何重建质量之间取得良好平衡，同时计算成本显著降低，模型存储具有竞争力。
conclusion: 该工作将2DGS与互信息主动视角选择结合，实现了高效且质量均衡的主动场景重建，有望提升资源受限平台上的实时重建与自主探索能力。

title: Adaptive World Memory 3D Foundation Model for Scalable 3D Mapping, Localization, and Rendering
abstract: Recent 3D foundation models enable generalizable geometric reasoning from RGB images but remain limited in persistent memory, scalability, and renderable scene modeling. We present a memory-centric 3D foundation model for scalable robotic localization, reconstruction, and Gaussian rendering. Its core is an adaptive world memory mechanism that combines transformer-based gated updates with test-time temporal-spatial regulation. Learned gates control recurrent memory propagation, while temporal state evolution and spatial observation-state consistency regulate token-wise updates and forgetting over long image sequences. To support large-scale mapping, we organize memory into local submaps and integrate progressive mapping and tracking, loop closure, and SL(4)-based global refinement to maintain local accuracy and global consistency. A Gaussian reconstruction head decodes memory-enhanced features into renderable primitives, unifying camera pose estimation, dense point-cloud reconstruction, and photorealistic rendering within a single model. Experiments on public benchmarks and self-collected datasets from diverse robotic platforms demonstrate improved trajectory accuracy, reconstruction completeness, and rendering quality over existing 3D foundation reconstruction and SLAM baselines. These results support adaptive memory as a foundation for persistent robotic world modeling. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at \href{https://github.com/dtc111111/AWM-3DFM}{https://github.com/dtc111111/AWM-3DFM}.
tldr: 提出自适应世界记忆3D基础模型，统一可扩展建图、定位与高斯渲染。
motivation: 现有3D基础模型能从RGB图像进行可泛化几何推理，但在持久记忆、可扩展性和可渲染场景建模方面仍受限。本文旨在以自适应记忆为核心，支持机器人持久世界建模与大规模场景理解。
method: 核心是自适应世界记忆机制，将Transformer门控更新与测试时时空调节结合，用学习门控控制循环记忆传播，并用时间状态演化和空间观测-状态一致性调节长序列中的token级更新与遗忘。方法将记忆组织为局部子图，结合渐进建图跟踪、回环检测和SL(4)全局优化；高斯重建头将记忆增强特征解码为可渲染基元，统一相机位姿估计、稠密点云重建和逼真渲染。
result: 在公开基准和多种机器人平台自采数据集上，所提方法在轨迹精度、重建完整性和渲染质量上优于现有3D基础重建与SLAM基线；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明自适应记忆可作为持久机器人世界建模的基础，并在单一模型中统一定位、重建与渲染。数据集和代码将公开，有望推动可扩展3D建图与定位研究。

title: VoxelTTO: Voxel-Aligned Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Test-Time Optimization
abstract: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods typically regress pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives, often causing excessive overlap and artifacts, while inaccuracies in predicted camera poses can lead to misalignment in novel-view synthesis (NVS). We present VoxelTTO, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing geometrically accurate 3DGS scenes from an arbitrary number of images and optional camera parameters. VoxelTTO aggregates dense image features into a global voxel representation and decodes Gaussians from voxel features, breaking the pixel-to-Gaussian correspondence. To exploit known camera parameters while keeping the pretrained visual foundation model (VFM) parameters frozen, we introduce test-time optimization (TTO) that adapts lightweight LoRA modules using pose supervision. We further replace vanilla 3DGS rasterization with stochastic solid volume rendering during training and inference, improving geometric fidelity. Training updates only the voxel-aligned Gaussian reconstruction modules, requiring 80 GPU hours. Experiments on Replica, Tanks and Temples, and DTU demonstrate improved RGB-D NVS and camera-pose estimation relative to prior methods.
tldr: VoxelTTO 用体素对齐高斯与测试时优化，提升前馈 3DGS 的几何精度、新视角合成和相机位姿估计。
motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 方法通常回归像素对齐的高斯基元，易造成过度重叠和伪影；同时预测相机位姿不准会导致新视角合成出现错位。VoxelTTO 旨在从任意数量图像和可选相机参数中重建几何精确的 3DGS 场景。
method: 该方法将密集图像特征聚合到全局体素表示，并从体素特征解码高斯，打破像素到高斯的对应关系；同时引入测试时优化，在冻结预训练视觉基础模型参数的情况下，用位姿监督适配轻量 LoRA 模块。训练和推理阶段还以随机实体体积渲染替代原生 3DGS 光栅化，仅更新体素对齐高斯重建模块，训练需 80 GPU 小时。
result: 在 Replica、Tanks and Temples 和 DTU 数据集上，VoxelTTO 相对先前方法提升了 RGB-D 新视角合成和相机位姿估计表现；训练成本为 80 GPU 小时。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: VoxelTTO 提出体素对齐的前馈 3DGS 框架，通过测试时优化和随机实体体积渲染提升几何保真度与位姿鲁棒性，为前馈 3DGS 重建提供了一种可融合可选相机参数且不依赖像素对齐的新思路。

title: Think Locally, Refine Globally for Memory-Efficient 3D Reconstruction
abstract: We propose LoG-VGGT, a memory-efficient framework for long-sequence 3D reconstruction that balances local temporal modeling with global camera consistency. Instead of relying on full global attention, our method introduces cross-window attention at a small subset of transformer blocks, enabling effective information propagation across adjacent temporal windows while keeping memory usage bounded. To mitigate long-term pose drift, we further design a global camera consistency refinement module, where camera tokens interact with compact register tokens via cross-attention to enforce scene-level constraints across the entire sequence. This design enables joint optimization of camera representations and significantly improves long-horizon pose stability without incurring the high cost of sequence-wide attention. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LoG-VGGT achieves improved depth accuracy and robust camera pose estimation across multiple long-sequence benchmarks, while delivering competitive streaming reconstruction performance.
tldr: 提出 LoG-VGGT，结合跨窗口注意力与全局相机一致性精炼，实现内存高效的长序列三维重建。
motivation: 长序列三维重建中，全全局注意力会带来高昂内存开销，而长期相机位姿漂移也会影响稳定性。该方法旨在有限内存下兼顾局部时序建模与全局相机一致性。
method: LoG-VGGT 仅在少量 Transformer 块中引入跨窗口注意力，使信息在相邻时间窗口间传播并保持内存有界；同时设计全局相机一致性精炼模块，让相机 token 与紧凑 register token 通过交叉注意力交互，在整个序列上施加场景级约束并联合优化相机表示，避免全序列注意力的高成本。
result: 在多个长序列基准上，LoG-VGGT 提升了深度精度与相机位姿估计鲁棒性，并展现出有竞争力的流式重建性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明局部窗口注意力与全局相机精炼的结合能有效缓解长期位姿漂移，在内存受限条件下实现高效长序列三维重建。该框架为长序列与流式三维重建提供了可扩展方案。

title: WS-NeRF: A Mamba-Driven World-State-Aware Adaptive Deblurring Neural Radiance Field
abstract: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have attracted extensive attention in recent years due to their strong capability for high-quality 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis from multi-view images. Existing methods usually rely on high-quality sharp inputs, while real-world image acquisition is highly susceptible to blur degradation, which severely affects the reconstruction quality of NeRF. In this paper, we propose a novel Mamba-driven world-state-aware adaptive deblurring neural radiance field, termed WS-NeRF, to address image degradation and 3D inconsistency. We formulate the alternating optimization of radiance fields as a dynamic evolution process with temporal memory, and jointly exploit comprehensive multi-dimensional world states and a mixture-of-experts mechanism to dynamically adjust the confidence of deblurring priors. Experimental results show that WS-NeRF significantly improves blurry radiance field reconstruction quality, achieving better performance on PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, while exhibiting more stable iterative recovery behavior.
tldr: 提出 Mamba 驱动的世界状态感知自适应去模糊 NeRF，以提升模糊输入下的三维重建质量。
motivation: 现有 NeRF 方法通常依赖高质量清晰输入，而真实场景图像采集易受模糊退化影响，严重降低 NeRF 的重建质量。研究旨在同时解决图像退化与三维不一致问题。
method: 提出 WS-NeRF，将辐射场的交替优化建模为带时间记忆的动态演化过程，并联合利用多维世界状态与混合专家机制动态调整去模糊先验置信度。该方法由 Mamba 驱动，实现自适应去模糊与辐射场重建的协同优化。
result: 实验表明 WS-NeRF 显著提升模糊辐射场重建质量，在 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 上取得更好表现，并呈现更稳定的迭代恢复行为；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: WS-NeRF 通过 Mamba、世界状态感知与自适应去模糊先验提升模糊输入下 NeRF 的重建质量与稳定性，为真实场景鲁棒三维重建提供新思路。

title: Cube-Splat: High-Fidelity 360° Gaussian Splatting SLAM via Cubemap Factorization and Adjoint-Consistent Optimization
abstract: Recent progress in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled dense visual SLAM with pinhole cameras, yet most pipelines are not designed for panoramic imagery. We present Cube-Splat, the first panoramic GS-SLAM framework that factorizes each 360° frame into a cubemap of four fixed-orientation virtual pinhole views sharing a single optical center. By designating the front face as the primary pose state, we accumulate gradients from all faces via an adjoint mapping, thereby enabling multi-face observations to coherently update a single state while strictly preserving cross-view geometric consistency. Concurrently, our mapping module densifies and optimizes anisotropic Gaussians using aggregated cubemap rays for high-fidelity, dense reconstruction. Furthermore, to rigorously evaluate panoramic SLAM under diverse and challenging conditions, we introduce SynPano, a highly scalable, photorealistic synthetic dataset featuring parameterized complex trajectories and multi-modal ground truth. Extensive evaluations on two public benchmarks (PALVIO and OmniBlender) and our SynPano dataset, collectively encompassing both indoor and outdoor scenes, demonstrate that Cube-Splat achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in tracking accuracy and reconstruction fidelity. Both the source code and the SynPano dataset are available at https://github.com/guoxf304/CubeSplat.
tldr: Cube-Splat 首次将全景图像分解为四路立方体贴图，并通过伴随映射实现高保真 360° 高斯泼溅 SLAM。
motivation: 现有 3DGS SLAM 多面向针孔相机，缺乏针对全景图像设计的管线。该工作旨在解决 360° 全景 SLAM 中多视图几何一致性保持与高保真稠密重建的难题。
method: 将每帧 360° 图像分解为共享单一光心的四个固定朝向虚拟针孔视图，以前面为主位姿状态，通过伴随映射聚合所有面的梯度，使多面观测一致更新单一状态并严格保持跨视图几何一致性。建图模块利用聚合立方体贴图光线稠密化并优化各向异性高斯，同时提出可扩展的写实合成数据集 SynPano，包含参数化复杂轨迹和多模态真值。
result: 在 PALVIO、OmniBlender 两个公开基准及自建 SynPano 数据集上（涵盖室内外场景）评估，Cube-Splat 在跟踪精度和重建保真度上均达到 SOTA；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: Cube-Splat 是首个全景 GS-SLAM 框架，核心贡献为立方体贴图分解与伴随一致优化，并发布 SynPano 数据集；源码与数据已开源，有望推动 360° SLAM 的高保真重建研究。

title: FOCAL-VLA: Subtask-Guided Geometry Distillation and Implicit World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models built on pretrained vision-language models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. However, VLA models that directly map current 2D observations to actions often lack sufficient spatial and temporal understanding, limiting their performance in precise and long-horizon manipulation. Recent methods enhance VLA models through geometric supervision and future-state prediction across the entire scene. However, these methods can suffer from redundant scene information, distracting the model from learning the geometry and dynamics relevant to the current interaction. To address this issue, we propose FOCAL-VLA, a framework that combines subtask-guided geometry distillation with implicit world modeling to learn representations of current spatial structure and future interaction dynamics. To focus geometric learning on the current subtask, we transfer geometric knowledge from VGGT to the VLA model by aligning geometry latents with features from subtask-relevant image regions. To capture the future 3D evolution of the current interaction, we incorporate implicit world modeling using Track4World features from current and future demonstration frames. The two complementary representations jointly guide action generation without running VGGT or Track4World at inference time. Experiments show that FOCAL-VLA outperforms baselines on both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. Project website: https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/FOCAL-VLA/.
tldr: FOCAL-VLA通过子任务引导几何蒸馏与隐式世界建模，提升视觉-语言-动作模型的空间与长时程操作能力。
motivation: 现有VLA模型直接将当前2D观测映射为动作，空间与时序理解不足；全场景几何监督和未来状态预测又引入冗余信息，干扰当前交互相关几何与动力学的学习。
method: FOCAL-VLA将VGGT的几何知识蒸馏到VLA模型，通过将几何隐变量与子任务相关图像区域特征对齐，实现子任务引导的几何学习；同时利用当前与未来示范帧的Track4World特征进行隐式世界建模，以预测当前交互的未来3D演化，两种表示联合指导动作生成且推理时无需运行VGGT或Track4World。
result: 实验表明，FOCAL-VLA在仿真基准和真实机器人操作任务上均优于基线方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法通过子任务聚焦的几何蒸馏与隐式世界建模，在不增加推理开销的情况下增强VLA的空间与时序理解，为精准长时程操作提供了有效方案，并展示了仿真与真实场景的泛化潜力。

title: VGGT-CAD: Reconstructing Parametric CAD 3D Model with Geometric Grounding
abstract: Parametric CAD reconstruction requires recovering both precise geometry and editable modeling operations from visual observations, making it challenging under limited and ambiguous views. Existing methods mainly rely on 2D appearance cues and lack strong multi-view geometric priors. In this work, we present VGGT-CAD, a geometry-aware framework for parametric CAD reconstruction from single- and multi-view observations. We transfer pretrained 3D geometric priors into CAD reconstruction by encoding camera parameters as condition tokens and jointly modeling them with image tokens. To handle varying numbers of viewpoints, we introduce a variable-view cross-view context aggregation module that adaptively fuses multi-view features. We further develop a training-free geometry-aware view selection strategy to select complementary and reliable frames during inference. The resulting representation is decoded into CAD command sequences using a non-autoregressive decoder. We also develop VideoCAD, a large-scale multi-view video benchmark derived from existing CAD data through multi-view re-rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of VGGT-CAD for visual CAD reconstruction under different observation configurations.
tldr: VGGT-CAD利用预训练3D几何先验与变视角聚合，从单/多视图重建可编辑参数化CAD模型。
motivation: 现有参数化CAD重建方法主要依赖2D外观线索，缺乏强多视图几何先验，在有限且模糊视角下难以同时恢复精确几何与可编辑建模操作。
method: 提出VGGT-CAD，将预训练3D几何先验迁移至CAD重建，把相机参数编码为条件token并与图像token联合建模；设计可变视角跨视图上下文聚合模块自适应融合多视图特征，并采用免训练几何感知视角选择策略；最终通过非自回归解码器输出CAD命令序列。
result: 构建了由现有CAD数据多视图重渲染得到的VideoCAD大规模多视图视频基准；大量实验表明VGGT-CAD在不同观测配置下均能有效完成视觉CAD重建，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: VGGT-CAD为视觉参数化CAD重建提供了几何感知框架，可处理单视图、多视图及可变视角输入，并贡献VideoCAD基准，对可编辑CAD逆向建模与多视图3D理解具有潜在影响。

title: Robust Structureless Monocular Visual Inertial Initialization Exploiting Line Features and Vanishing Points
abstract: Accurate initialization is essential for reliable visual-inertial odometry (VIO), but it is often ill-conditioned under degenerate motions. Existing methods typically require restrictive excitation motions to ensure sufficient observability or rely on computationally expensive 3D structure reconstruction, limiting efficient and practical deployment. To address these limitations, we propose SLIM-init, a structureless monocular VIO initializer that directly exploits geometric constraints from tracked 2D line features without explicit 3D landmark reconstruction. Specifically, SLIM-init leverages line-derived vanishing points (VPs) as translation-invariant orientation cues to provide robust rotation-only constraints under degenerate scenarios such as low-parallax or translation-dominant motions. It further incorporates a line epipolar residual to constrain translation and a line-normal projection residual to improve the conditioning of linear alignment, enhancing the accuracy and robustness of initial state estimation. Extensive experiments on a public benchmark and challenging custom degenerate-motion sequences demonstrate improved accuracy and robustness over state-of-the-art initialization methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/cjunwan/SLIM-init.
tldr: 提出SLIM-init，利用线特征与消失点实现无结构单目视觉惯性鲁棒初始化。
motivation: 单目VIO初始化在退化运动下常病态；现有方法需强激励运动或昂贵的3D结构重建，难以兼顾效率与实用性。
method: SLIM-init无需显式3D路标重建，直接利用跟踪的2D线特征几何约束：以线导出的消失点提供平移不变的旋转约束，以线对极残差约束平移，并用线法向投影残差改善线性对齐条件数。
result: 在公开基准和自建挑战性退化运动序列上，SLIM-init相比最先进初始化方法在精度和鲁棒性上均有提升；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法为退化运动下的单目VIO提供无需3D重建的高效初始化方案，代码已开源，有望提升实际部署的鲁棒性。

title: 4DGS-Fixer: Generative Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting with Iterative Refinement Guided by Video Diffusion Priors
abstract: This paper addresses the challenges of dynamic scene synthesis from sparse-view videos. Existing methods employ geometric priors, adaptive optimization, or density-control strategies to improve 4D Gaussian modeling under sparse observations. However, they cannot fundamentally resolve the ill-posed problem caused by insufficient observations and missing scene information. Moreover, sparse-view 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) often suffers from poor geometric initialization: with only a few input views, COLMAP typically reconstructs sparse and incomplete point clouds, leaving large scene regions without sufficient Gaussian support and making them difficult to recover through subsequent optimization. To address these limitations, we propose a novel iterative refinement framework based on a video diffusion model to improve the completeness and consistency of dynamic 4D scenes. Specifically, we first estimate multi-view depth maps and fuse them into dense point clouds to provide more complete geometric initialization for a dynamic 4DGS representation. We then employ a pretrained video restoration model to refine sequences rendered along novel camera trajectories at different time steps. The restored sequences serve as pseudo-supervision to regularize and iteratively refine the 4DGS representation. Experiments on a widely used benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms existing baselines, achieving nearly a 2 dB PSNR improvement over the previous best-performing method.
tldr: 提出4DGS-Fixer，利用视频扩散先验与迭代细化，从稀疏视图视频生成完整一致的动态4D高斯场景。
motivation: 稀疏视图动态场景合成本质病态，现有几何先验、自适应优化或密度控制无法从根本上解决观测不足与场景信息缺失；同时COLMAP点云稀疏不完整导致4DGS几何初始化差，大片区域缺乏高斯支撑且难以优化恢复。
method: 先估计多视角深度图并融合为稠密点云，为动态4DGS提供更完整几何初始化；再利用预训练视频修复模型细化沿新相机轨迹、不同时间步渲染的序列，并将修复序列作为伪监督迭代正则化与优化4DGS表示。
result: 在常用基准数据集上显著优于现有基线，相比此前最佳方法实现近2 dB的PSNR提升。
conclusion: 该框架通过视频扩散先验引导的伪监督迭代修复，缓解稀疏视图4DGS的病态性与几何初始化不足，提升动态场景完整性与一致性，为稀疏视图动态重建提供新思路。

title: SplashSplat: Reconstructing Splashing Liquids from Real-World Multi-View Videos
abstract: A splash lives for a fraction of a second: sheets tear into ligaments and droplets, appearance is view-dependent and nearly textureless, and little persists long enough to track. Reconstruction research has consequently focused on smoke, synthetic liquids, or gently deforming surfaces. To our knowledge, no synchronized multi-view dataset of splashing liquids exists. We therefore introduce a benchmark of 20 real scenes, from coherent streams to violent splashes, captured by seven synchronized, calibrated 4K cameras at 60 fps, with manually refined per-view liquid and container masks and fixed evaluation splits. We further present SplashSplat, built on a single principle: impose physical structure only where the observations can constrain it. Per-frame liquid SDFs fused from the masks provide the geometry, level-set transport between consecutive SDFs yields a coarse velocity field, and Lagrangian carriers advected along this flow, corrected against each new observation and reseeded where coverage is lost, decode local Gaussians for differentiable rendering. SplashSplat outperforms state-of-the-art dynamic Gaussian splatting methods on our real captures and on a synthetic benchmark, with physically more plausible motion and a lower training cost. The same representation supports temporal interpolation and style transfer without re-optimization.
tldr: 提出首个真实多视角飞溅液体数据集，并用物理约束的SplashSplat实现动态高斯重建。
motivation: 飞溅液体仅持续瞬间，液片会撕裂成韧带和液滴，表观视角依赖且近乎无纹理，难以长期追踪；现有重建研究多集中于烟雾、合成液体或缓慢形变表面。据作者所知，此前不存在同步多视角的飞溅液体数据集。
method: 构建包含20个真实场景的基准，涵盖连贯水流到剧烈飞溅，使用7台同步标定4K相机以60fps拍摄，并提供逐视角精修液体与容器掩码及固定评估划分。提出SplashSplat，仅在观测可约束处施加物理结构：由掩码融合逐帧液体SDF作为几何，通过相邻SDF间水平集传输得到粗速度场，并沿流场平流拉格朗日载体，经新观测校正、覆盖丢失处重播种后解码局部高斯进行可微渲染。
result: 在真实捕获和合成基准上，SplashSplat优于最先进的动态高斯泼溅方法，具有更合理的物理运动和更低的训练成本；同一表示还支持无需重优化的时间插值与风格迁移。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 贡献包括首个同步多视角飞溅液体基准数据集与按观测约束施加物理结构的SplashSplat框架，为真实飞溅液体动态重建、时间插值和风格迁移提供统一表示，并有望推动复杂流体场景的可微分重建研究。

title: PhGS: Post-Hoc Pruning and Refinement of Single-View Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Reconstructions
abstract: Recent single-view feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) generation predicts a fixed number of Gaussians per camera ray, introducing severe spatial redundancy. Most existing compaction strategies target multi-view setups to exploit cross-view consistency and are incompatible with single-image models. Instead of retraining the base feed-forward network to directly output compact representations, our insight is to keep the base models frozen and apply post-hoc pruning and recurrent refinement to the generated Gaussians. Consequently, we propose a backbone-agnostic compaction pipeline for single-view feed-forward 3DGS that couples an importance-score-based pruning mechanism with a trainable, lightweight recurrent refinement module, which iteratively updates the surviving primitives to restore image quality. Our results demonstrate seamless integration with existing baselines while preserving novel-view rendering fidelity and achieving high memory reduction. Furthermore, our method supports flexible inference-time keep ratios for application needs.
tldr: PhGS 对单视图前馈 3DGS 生成结果进行事后剪枝与循环精炼，在保持渲染质量的同时大幅降低内存。
motivation: 单视图前馈 3DGS 沿每条相机射线预测固定数量高斯，造成严重空间冗余；现有压缩方法面向多视图依赖跨视图一致性，无法直接用于单图模型。
method: 提出与主干无关的事后压缩管线：冻结基础前馈网络，基于重要性评分剪枝生成的高斯，并用轻量可训练循环精炼模块迭代更新存活图元以恢复图像质量；支持推理时灵活设置保留比例。
result: 摘要显示方法可与现有基线无缝集成，保持新视角渲染保真度并实现高内存压缩，且支持按应用需求调整推理时保留比率；具体压缩率与质量指标未给出量化数值。
conclusion: PhGS 无需重训练基础模型即可压缩单视图前馈 3DGS，提供骨干无关、支持可变保留率的通用方案，有助于推动单图三维重建在内存受限场景落地。

title: RawSLAM: Online HDR Gaussian SLAM from Linear Radiance
abstract: Current dense visual SLAM systems rely almost exclusively on 8-bit tonemapped Low Dynamic Range (LDR) inputs, limiting their robustness in extreme lighting where shadows and highlights trigger tracking drift and mapping collapse. Conversely, existing raw and High Dynamic Range (HDR) reconstruction pipelines operate strictly offline. They depend on Structure-from-Motion preprocessing and are not suited for large inter-frame motion.
